title: Saudi Arabian Date Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dessert made with dates, nuts, and a hint of spices.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and 1 tablespoon of warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes until it becomes frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and allspice.
Add the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a thick circle.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a small pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until they are lightly toasted.
Spread the toasted almonds over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange the pitted dates on top of the almonds.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake the tagine for 25-30 minutes until it is golden brown.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
